name: FAB (Features, Advantages, Benefits)
summary: For each key feature, explain the advantage it gives and the benefit the buyer gets, ending with a clear next step.
references: Sales training model; see Neil Rackham, SPIN Selling (1988)
title_style: Benefit-first titles, under 12 words; the feature appears in the body.

sequence.purpose: Name the product and who it serves.
Feature: what it is or does.
The next step for the buyer.

pitfalls: Listing features without ever reaching a benefit.
Benefits that the buyer did not ask for.

example.topic: A fictional furniture maker selling a folding desk
outline: Quietdesk: a standing desk for small apartments
Small rooms make standing desks feel huge
Folds flat against the wall in one motion
Takes a quarter of the floor of a normal desk
Your room is a living room again after work
Book a home trial this month
